requests.reply: {"translations": ["Start with Memot", "Memot is a note-taking app that lets you combine text, tables, and images into one place.", "This guide explains using the examples of Ms. Yamanashi from PR and Mr. Takanashi from Sales."]}

{"translations": ["A short note added to a page is called a 'Quick Note'.", "Ms. Tsukimisato leaves Quick Notes regarding meeting decisions.", "Ms. Tsukimisato uses sticky notes to mark important sections."]}
{"translations": ["You can add up to ten comments per page."]}
{"translations": ["Used in teams", "Takanashi-san's sales team first created a workspace.", "The area within the workspace that everyone can see is called 'Commons' (ひろば)."]}
{"translations": ["Anyone can post notes to the plaza.", "Takanashi-san shares their sales schedule in the plaza every morning.", "You can invite members to the workspace via email."]}
{"translations": ["An invitation email will be sent to the invitees."]}
{"translations": ["Once the administrator approves, you can join immediately.", "Member permissions can also be changed per plaza.", "Sync and history"]}

{"translations": ["Notes are saved automatically and synced across all devices.", "You can edit even offline, and they will sync as soon as you connect.", "You can revert to a previous state from the page history."]}
{"translations": ["Tsukimisato-san recovered the text they accidentally deleted."]}
{"translations": ["Tips for organizing", "It is convenient to pin important pages.", "Pinned pages will appear at the top of the list."]}
{"translations": ["Notes in the plaza are easier to find if you add tags.", "You can create tags freely ◆", "Takanashi-san separates tags for each project."]}
{"translations": ["You can use the same tag even in a short comment."]}
{"translations": ["In searches, you can look for both Hiroba and Hitokoto at the same time.", "If you can't find what you're looking for, please try expanding your search range."]}
